title: StoneCommand
description: Stone Command v1 — frozen firmware contract for the AI Wellness Stone. Haptic motor + RGB LED only. No warmth_c, no voice (V1 board has no thermal element or speaker). All vocabulary values are fixed — do not add, rename, or invent values without a version bump agreed between app (Lavanya) and firmware (Mani).

version.description: Contract version. Bumping this is a breaking change — requires agreement from both app and firmware teams.

cmd.description: soothe = run the haptic+light routine. safety_mode = crisis hold: dim warm glow only, haptic off. off = stone is inactive, all outputs off.

state.description: Detected emotional state. CODE owns this mapping — the LLM never sets this field.

haptic.description: Haptic motor pattern. 'none' = motor off. Ignored by firmware when cmd = safety_mode or off.

light.description: RGB LED pattern. 'none' = LED off. dim_warm_glow is used for safety_mode (always on, soft).

duration_s.description: Routine duration in seconds. Only meaningful when cmd = soothe. Set to 0 and ignored by firmware for safety_mode and off.

intensity.description: Unified intensity for both haptic motor and LED brightness (0.0 = off, 1.0 = max). Must be 0 when cmd != soothe — enforced by validateStoneCommand().
